name: keyquorum-relay-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for the KeyQuorum relay: the public Worker and the Durable Object that runs the Rust relay core as WebAssembly. `builds:build`, `check` and `preview` are the commands Cloudflare Workers Builds runs once the repository is connected (docs/operator/relay-hosting.md).

scripts.check:console-preview: node --test scripts/console-preview.test.mjs scripts/wrangler-dry-run.test.mjs && node scripts/wrangler-dry-run.mjs --config preview/wrangler.json --outdir dist/console-preview && node scripts/guard.mjs --bundle dist/console-preview --max-gzip-bytes 3145728
scripts.preview:console: npm run builds:console && npm run check:console-preview && wrangler preview --config preview/wrangler.json
scripts.guard: node scripts/guard.mjs wrangler.toml --allow-preview-urls --allow-r2 && node scripts/guard.mjs admin/wrangler.toml && node scripts/guard.mjs spike/wrangler.toml
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/staging --env staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/admin --env="" -c admin/wrangler.toml && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/admin-staging --env staging -c admin/wrangler.toml
scripts.check: node scripts/ensure-relay-wasm.mjs && npm run guard && npm run build && npm run guard:bundle
